designs.lens: Research-objective and contract continuity: where learning belongs inside b = K(e + C_G b) given which learned objects have met their gates, whether an ECRO-type composed operator sits inside, beside or outside the K/C contract, and what a surface-only mechanism must look like to survive GM2-GM4. Labels used throughout: [impl] verified implementation fact, [meas] measured evidence, [wl] a worklog's interpretation, [inf] my inference, [hyp] unverified hypothesis.
designs.problem_reconstruction:
Exact physics. With optical domains a, the contract (Architecture.md sections 2-3) is i_a = e_a + sum_b C_ab(G) b_b, b_a = K_a[i_a]. K maps an incident boundary field (position, direction, material coordinates) to the outgoing field at first exit into free space; C_G carries an outgoing event through editable air to the next entry. Every path segment has one owner. With the frozen ER closure K is pointwise: (S_ER i)(x, w_o) = integral f_ER(w_i, w_o) i(x, w_i) cos dw_i, so b = q + T_G b with T_G = S_ER C_G, q = S_ER e, and b = sum_n T_G^n q. Everything in this paragraph is exact given ER; ER's own bias against the layered material is a separate measured quantity g (0.017 stationary, 0.056-0.069 on sharp regions, WL85 [meas]).

Four things can be learned, and they are different kinds of object.
(i) Intrinsic K: a rule phi(material, intrinsic geometry) -> response. Its arguments exclude scene geometry and sources, so it is rigid-invariant and source-independent by definition. What is replaced is intrinsic micro-transport (layered walk, in-medium random walk). The approximation error is a local bias; the decomposition stays exact.
(ii) Coupling C_G: a deterministic function of geometry (visibility plus measure). There is no hidden physics to learn; a learned C is amortised computation or compression of a ray cast.
(iii) Higher-order response R_G^(k) = sum_{n>=k} T_G^n (or the resolvent (I - T_G)^-1): a source-independent linear operator that depends on all geometry and all materials. Exact as an operator; a learned generator G -> R_hat is a function over a distribution of scenes. ECRO v0 is this with events 2-5 in a table.
(iv) A compressed representation of the composed system: a projection onto a finite basis (patch x direction bin, rank-r factors), b_hat = Pi b or T_hat = Pi T Pi. Optional; may be filled physically or by a learned generator; its error is projection bias (a fixed-bandwidth mollifier).

Exact physical decompositions: K/C segments; Neumann event order; ballistic versus scattered; K's finite lobe mixture (f_ER is a sum of 8 lobes). Optional computational approximations: truncation order, basis, rank, state-ray count, receiver-side gather versus sender-side shooting quadrature, stored versus recomputed state, and any learned generator of (ii)-(iv).

Contract reading [inf]. Architecture section 4 has a row "reusable rule parameters = source-independent intrinsic material/medium response" (object (i)) and rows for geometry state, cached coefficients, free-space state and radiance, all of which are computed, invalidated or "recomputed through the current coupled solve". A learned generator of (ii), (iii) or (iv) is a fifth kind of object - learned parameters whose validity domain is a distribution of scene geometries - for which the contract has no row and no validity semantics. ECRO's generator is that fifth object: [impl] it is trained on 1,024 box poses of one room family with fixed stationary geometry; its operator is B = a(c E1 + P Q u), u = c s (model86.py apply), i.e. S_hat F S_hat s + S_hat (PQ) S_hat s with S_hat = a c^T a learned rank-16 per-patch scattering on the 64x64 bin grid, F the 512-ray state flight and PQ a rank-24 visibility-free remainder. So ECRO (a) keeps exclusive ownership by event count, (b) replaces "recompute through the coupled solve" by a one-shot learned operator, and (c) re-represents the local scattering that ER already owns in a second, binned, geometry-conditioned form inside the learned part. It sits beside the K/C contract, not inside it; no canonical document records this [meas: dossier contradiction list].

what_each_learnable_object_must_preserve.intrinsic_K: Linearity and non-negativity in the incident field; passivity certified over the closed hemisphere and over every (entry point, direction) the composition can query, not on a probe set (WL42 hinge bound one direction only: rho 0.68 at the normal, 9.4-17.1 off-normal, WL46 [meas]; WL81 finite-grid supremum misses grazing [meas]); reciprocity where physical; material-frame equivariance so rigid motion needs only a frame transform (WL53: K invariant within 1.00-1.05x seed noise [meas]); incident-direction dependence where transport is direction-selective (WL47 mirror cavity 0.98-1.11 difference at equal irradiance; not needed within 1-2 % for Burley SSS [meas]); a continuous outgoing directional distribution with exact eval / sample / pdf so that C can be driven from the sender (WL46: directional read + lobe sampling +8.4 dB [meas]); for nonlocal K the entry -> first-exit position distribution including sub-port structure near contact (WL55: +10 to +22 % outgoing flux error at 1 cm [meas]); ballistic and scattered terms as separate families (WL55 -33.5 % -> -1.7 % [meas]); path-history independence and the same rule for direct and C-mediated incidence (WL51, Architecture section 2).
what_each_learnable_object_must_preserve.coupling_C: Binary visibility with its discontinuities; the geometric measure (radiance invariance along rays, closure <= 1, reciprocity); the directional correspondence between the sender's outgoing direction and the receiver's incoming direction at the resolution of the sharper of the two lobes involved; convex sub-port source structure for pairs closer than a port (WL54: +6 to +44 % from pairs < 1 cm [meas]); same-domain exit/re-entry; and the dependency of each relation on third-party geometry (which edits invalidate it). C carries no material information of its own, but the density with which it is sampled must follow K's outgoing lobe (WL86A amendment 2: 512 lobe-independent rays give -20 % and patch RMS 0.50-0.93 for the panel family even with exact sender radiance [meas, post hoc]).
what_each_learnable_object_must_preserve.higher_order_response: Exclusive accounting against whatever is computed physically (no family owned twice, none dropped); geometry-specific spatial placement, which requires visibility along every flight it stands for (ECRO's visibility-free rank-24 term added +0.017 to +0.064 regardless of geometry, WL86A [meas]); linearity in the source; an energy bound (flux no larger than the Neumann sum it replaces); correctness per path family at the locations a sharp reader weights, not in aggregate (back-wall field error 0.044 = oracle noise and flux 0.995-1.006 while the mirror reader saw a 7-10 % deficit, WL86A [meas]); and signed edit response in every class, including sharp receivers (WL86 region-C slope 0.36-0.63, ungated [meas]).
what_each_learnable_object_must_preserve.compressed_composed_system: A declared basis whose projection bias is known to be below the gate for the families it owns (oracle projection: E_H 0.003 stationary, 0.0137 in the hardest region on the WL86 room [meas]; a 64/256-bin interface loses 52-80 % at GGX alpha 0.04, WL58 [meas]); an error measure weighted by reader importance; the dependency map from entries to geometry so that selective and full rebuild are defined and equal; compression error smaller than the edit-induced change it is meant to track (WL57/59: learned K 6-7 % versus stale exact K 0.5-1.2 % [meas]); and an explicit statement of the training distribution if any part is learned, because its parameters are then scene-family state, not an intrinsic rule [inf].

historical_failure_synthesis.common_to_four_part_K_and_ECRO:
Checked item by item; I do not find one common cause.

1. Exclusive path ownership. Both keep the OUTER partition exclusive and lose it INSIDE the learned part. Four-term K: the K/C split was enforced by how probes were rendered (target contains no free-space transport, WL51 [meas]); the nonlocal terms K_glob / K_band / K_mid were fitted jointly to one residual with nested supports and no partition [impl], against FNTO v0.1 line 74. ECRO: LOW (<= 2 events, path-traced) versus HIGH (table) is exclusive [impl]; the single flight and the rank-24 remainder were trained on their sum only [impl], and the remainder absorbed the light -> panel -> patch family (+0.02 to +0.06, WL86A [meas]; the term split is an analysis convention). Additional point for ECRO only [impl + inf]: its learned part contains a second representation of local scattering (rank-16 factors a, c on a 64x64 bin grid, generated from geometry tokens) while the LOW part uses exact ER, so the same K is represented twice; the panel's own outgoing table is 0.28-0.31 wrong even on training geometries [meas].

2. Directional support. Common [inf]: the free-space relation was sampled on the receiver side with a material-independent budget (K44: 128 cosine gathers per port; ECRO: 512 stratified rays per patch, 8 per incident bin) and the sender was read at fixed angular resolution (K44: isotropic / normal-direction, 5-9x low at the normal, WL48; ECRO: per-bin). Sharp transport failed exactly where a narrow sender lobe met that sampling (WL46: -16 % with cosine gathers versus -0.4 % with lobe sampling; WL86A: median 13-17 panel-hitting rays per important patch, patch RMS 0.50-0.93). Not common: ECRO's output container was adequate for what it was asked to hold (oracle 0.003-0.014), whereas K44's irradiance interface was an information limit only for direction-selective interiors (WL47).

3. Identifiable learning targets. Common [inf]: the loss was defined on an aggregate that the composition later reads with a different weighting. K44 was supervised at camera directions of visible pixels and read by the solver at other ports and directions (82 % of predicted Yellow indirect came from ports no camera saw, WL45 [meas]). ECRO was trained with an unweighted relative-L2 over 81,280 entries and read through a near-mirror that concentrates on a few patches (aggregate gate G1 1.12-1.13 passed while box patches were 1.6-2.7x worse on unseen geometry [meas]). Not common: K44 additionally had the wrong operator as target (camera-vertex Burley versus interior Lambert, WL51), which has no ECRO counterpart.

4. Stable repeated application. NOT common. K44 and the WL50 arms were applied recursively and diverged (rho 10.47; 6.9-9.0 = gain 8.08-10.47 x return 0.85) unless a one-direction hinge suppressed the sender. ECRO is applied once and showed no instability (flux 0.98-1.00, one geometry [meas]). ECRO bought stability by not composing; the price is that all geometry-specific multi-bounce structure must live in a term without visibility.

5. Principled computational partition. Common [inf]: both partitions were chosen for computational convenience and neither is aligned with where a finite-rank or fixed-bin approximation is physically justified. K44 split by distance and rank (representatives cover 29 % of the red in-support response, WL49 [meas]). ECRO split by event count, which is exclusive but places a caustic-type family (light -> sharp sender -> diffuse receiver, 12-19 % of region C's reading) on the stored side; every classical multi-pass system routes that family to a sender-side pass (prior-art survey: Jensen 1996, Veach Theorem 8.3). Neither derived its partition from K's own lobe structure, which is the only exact partition of unity the material provides.
mechanism_specific_findings: K44 divergence (WL41/42/50): driven by the Cycles object-scoped Burley reference being applied only at vertices without a diffuse ancestor (WL51: diffuse-ancestor patch exactly 0 where the camera saw 0.845). Specific to that reference and to a single history-independent K trained on camera-vertex targets; the SEM substitution alone gives rho 0.79.
K44 box / shadow errors (WL42): supervision incident-field defects, removed by WL44 (+1.56 dB, box 16 -> 32 dB) without changing the kernel family.
K44 normal-direction sender deficit and the one-direction passivity hinge: specific to an isotropic sender evaluated at the port normal.
Representative-sampled supports (K_band / K_mid): information loss fixed by full-coverage quadrature at 2.2-2.8x elements (WL49); specific to that aggregation.
Dense O(N*M) learned coupling (WL52 GLT): 44 / 672 ms versus 5.0 / 11.1 ms explicit; specific to dense pair evaluation, although the explicit-C cost bar it lost to is general.

WL57-80 learned intrinsic K: transfer limited to 5-18 mm from supervised sources, far-boundary contrast 0.79-0.82 against oracles 0.16-0.27 (WL75), late-training drift, absolute-position leakage (WL78). Specific to a geometry -> spatial-factor map with a global angular basis on one slab; partly confounded by single-scatter quadrature noise (WL77A, non-evidence).

ECRO sharp failure (WL86/86A): a level error of a few Lambert patches fed by a sharp sender; proximate cause the learned single flight (1-18 % delivered) with compensation by the remainder; state relation sampling-limited (marginal, post hoc); capacity and coverage indeterminate. Not a failure of the output table, the 16-point source estimator, or (for point lights) the source encoding.
ECRO selective update has no economic content at this state size (20.8 versus 28.1 ms); the generator and application are re-run in full after every edit [impl].
constraints_on_any_future_architecture: Exactly one owner per path segment or path class, including between additive learned terms: jointly fitted additive terms without separately identified targets compensate for each other (K_glob carried 86 % of the Yellow mode, WL51; ECRO remainder +0.02 to +0.06, WL86A).

Anything applied recursively needs passivity certified on the whole queried domain (closed hemisphere, unsupervised ports and directions); linearity plus non-negative coefficients is not enough (WL41/42/46/50; WL81).
The supervision target must be the operator the composition applies at that path position, taken from a path-history-independent, qualified reference (WL51, WL53, WL83 -> WL84).

A fixed piecewise-constant angular interface cannot carry sharp lobes (WL58: 52-80 % loss at alpha 0.04; WL86A identical-encoding beam pairs differ 0.62-0.94, post hoc). A sharp sender's contribution has to be placed by sampling or integrating the sender's lobe, not by receiver-side lobe-independent gathering (WL46, WL48 KF, WL86A amendment 2; Veach Theorem 8.3).

Evaluation must be per path family and reader-importance weighted; aggregate field error, flux conservation, whole-image PSNR and first-event fidelity did not predict composed or sharp-receiver behaviour (WL42 -> WL44/45, WL49 -> WL50, WL86 -> WL86A).

Representability of the family (direct fit / oracle) must be shown before a generator is trained (WL81 rule), and oracle existence is not evidence that a geometry-conditioned rule can produce it (WL71-75: oracle 0.13-0.17, learned transfer 0.79-0.82).

A learned object that takes scene geometry as input must beat the learning-free operator built from the same geometry state, and the whole mechanism must beat quality-matched path tracing: explicit C update 5-11 ms (WL52); Cycles 4 spp 4.7 s versus 190 s oracle update (WL67); cold frozen-ER path tracing reaches the ER-gap level in 0.39 s GPU on the WL85 fixture.
On sharp receivers fidelity to REF-ER is bounded in meaning by ER's own gap g of 0.059-0.065, the same size as the WL86 gate (0.06).

Rigid-first designs must state what happens under deformation: intrinsic change is not generally local or low-rank (WL53 bend rank90 133-151), and a stale K recovers 1-20 % of a receiver's change (WL56).
Port- or patch-discretised K/C interfaces need sub-port resolution on both sides near contact (WL54/55). This binds discretised interfaces, not continuous ones.

Uncertain rather than binding: whether passivity requirements transfer to one-shot (non-recursive) learned operators; whether the WL57-80 transfer failures are properties of the model class or of training scale and label noise.

sharp_transport_answers.is_finite_ray_sampling_incompatible: No, not as such. [meas] A path tracer with finite rays resolves the same family (WL85 enabled-region reference uncertainty 0.006 against a change of 0.105; WL86 oracle table 0.0137 in region C) because it draws the sender's outgoing direction from the sender's lobe or connects to the light. What failed is a specific combination: a fixed, receiver-side, lobe-independent relation (512 cosine-stratified rays per patch, 8 per incident bin) reading per-bin sender radiance. With exact panel radiance that relation gives -20 % in aggregate and patch RMS 0.50-0.93; with bin-averaged radiance -16 / -26 % and 0.38-0.47; a Lambert patch sees the panel through a median of 13-17 of 512 rays (WL86A amendment 2; post hoc, two cases, one ray realisation, 0.4-point margin in one case). The same pattern appears in WL46 (128 cosine gathers: -16 % versus -0.4 % with lobe sampling) and WL48 (0.139 versus 0.034 with 2048 rays). [inf] What is incompatible with sharp transport is the conjunction 'source-independent AND stored AND fixed budget': a relation that must be valid for every incident direction on a sharp sender needs samples growing as alpha^-2 per sender point (WL84A derivation: about 16/alpha^2 angular samples, 4D count about alpha^-4/d^2). For a known source the count is bounded by the number of lit sender points times lobe samples.
sharp_transport_answers.support_without_exhaustive_rays: [inf] The support of light -> sharp sender -> receiver is fixed by three things that are all known without receiver-side search: the incident field at the sender (direct light at the first event is exact), the sender's lobe (ER is a closed-form GGX mixture with exact sample / pdf), and geometry. Support can therefore be found from the sender side - sampling the sender's lobe and casting only those rays, or integrating the lobe over the receiver polygon in closed form as in Xu et al. 2014 - at a cost per light proportional to lit sender area times lobe samples. This makes support discovery an application-time (source-dependent) computation. That is consistent with the contract, which requires only the RULE to be source-independent and says radiance is recomputed through the current solve; it is inconsistent with ECRO's choice to make the whole relation source-independent stored state. For chains of several sharp vertices the support is a discrete set of manifold solutions whose cost grows with chain length; the prior-art survey found no stored representation that keeps that under edits. In-project evidence is thin: only WL46 (hybrid with an analytic plane, +3.1 dB sampling, +8.4 dB with directional reads). A sender-driven relation was never run in the ECRO setting, so this answer is not measured there.
sharp_transport_answers.role_of_material_angular_structure: [inf from meas] It is the only principled source of both the partition and the sampling density. ER's lobe mixture is an exact sum, so a path-space partition by lobe index is exact, and each lobe's width says whether its exit field can be held at low angular resolution or must be sampled. The WL85 census sets the scale: on the general population about half of the albedo is broad; on the hard population a median 94 % sits in moderate lobes (r50 0.15-0.45 rad) and 4 % in broad ones; the sharp share rises toward grazing (median 0.51 at 80 degrees). Architecture section 2 already states the right reading: glossiness controls angular selectivity, not the strength of coupling. Material structure also decides whether incident direction matters at all (WL47: yes for a mirror cavity, no within 1-2 % for Burley SSS; WL66: 3-5 incoming contrast directions for a homogeneous slab). Neither failed mechanism used it: K44's nonlocal terms had an isotropic exit; ECRO fed the 69-float ER state through a 16-dimensional embedding and re-learned scattering as rank-16 factors on a 0.35-rad bin grid [impl], against a panel lobe of r50 about 0.15 rad.
sharp_transport_answers.preserve_support_or_aggregate: It depends on the reader's importance, and a state that is reader-independent must be designed for the sharpest reader. [meas] The back-wall table was correct in aggregate (relative L1 0.044 = oracle noise, flux 0.995-1.006) and still produced a 7-10 % deficit through the near-mirror panel, because a few patches 8-26 % low carried most of the weight. So: aggregation is admissible only for families in which both the last sender lobe and every possible reader lobe are broad; a family with a sharp sender must keep its spatial footprint on the receiver, and a family read by a sharp reader must be right patch by patch. [meas] The 1,270-patch container did preserve that footprint when filled by path tracing (0.0137), so on this room the support was representable; it was the operator - a low-rank remainder and an under-sampled flight - that turned support into an aggregate. [inf, theory from the survey] Low rank is aggregation: Mahajan et al. and Lessig and Fiume bound rank below by a space-bandwidth product, so a global low-rank factor can hold broad transport over large regions or sharp transport over small ones, not both.
sharp_transport_answers.representability_vs_identifiability:
Three levels have to be kept apart, and the project has evidence at different levels for different objects.
(a) Container representability: shown for ECRO's table on one room (oracle E_H 0.003; region C 0.0137; panel 0.0115-0.0121) [meas].
(b) Operator-family representability - does a member of the learned family meet the gate: NOT shown for ECRO. The free-factor fit on the E2 T1 geometry leaves 49-68 % of the deficit, confounded with optimisation, the loss and the fixed 512 rays [meas, post hoc]. Shown as oracles for the WL68-75 intrinsic K (fit 0.13-0.17 at rank 16).
(c) Identifiability from the supervision actually used - does training select that member: not shown for any geometry-conditioned object in the project. ECRO's sum-only unweighted loss does not identify the single-flight term, and a patch-level signal with 50-90 % sampling error is one a squared-error fit would suppress (WL86A inference, untested). WL71-75: equal-fit runs disagree on held-out sources (0.668 versus 0.860, WL78). WL47: a direction-aware map is recovered only with full-boundary supervision.
The only learned object with both (b) and (c) established is ER (direct-fit ceiling WL82, compiler generalisation WL83, rendering qualification WL84), and it takes no scene geometry [meas]. Source-encoding sufficiency is a fourth, separate matter: sufficient for the three point-light cases (ENC_ALL explains <= 5 %), not for narrow beams on the sharp sender [meas, second part post hoc].
sharp_transport_answers.avoiding_global_term_compensation:
[inf] Compensation is the expected behaviour of any free additive term fitted jointly to a sum; the survey records the same in MRT's 'intelligent ambient' mode and in VPL clamping plus compensation. The evidence supports three structural ways out, none of them tested by retraining:
(1) No free additive learned remainder: higher orders are produced by re-applying the physically structured operator (with visibility on every flight). This re-introduces recursion and therefore the passivity requirement.
(2) Term-wise targets with exclusive ownership: the path tracer can supply the truth split by event order and last sender (WL86A amendment 1 computed it), so each term can be supervised on its own family.
(3) Restrict the remainder by construction to a class in which geometry-blind low-rank mixing is physically adequate (broad sender and broad reader), and give every sharp-sender family to a sender-driven physical estimator.
[meas] What is established is only the symptom: the remainder added +0.017 to +0.064 on E2 and +0.039 / +0.041 on E1 where the family is 1.4 % of the reading, which produced opposite signs on the two edits. Removing a term at evaluation (0.49-0.52 field error either way) is not a retrained ablation, so how much each term 'needs' the other is not known.

hypotheses.name: H1 - Intrinsic-only learning: K as a certified, sampleable first-exit closure; coupling and the multi-bounce solve stay physically computed and are sampled from K; no learned global operator
hypotheses.central_principle: In b = K(e + C_G b) exactly one factor is at once rigid-invariant in material coordinates, source-independent by physics, and expensive to compute physically: K. C_G is a cheap deterministic function of geometry, and the cost of the solve is a sampling cost, not a missing function. [inf from meas] Every learned object that took scene geometry as an input failed on transfer or on economics against explicit geometry (learned C, WL52; geometry -> spatial factor, WL57-80; ECRO generator, WL86 sharp class), and the one learned object that met its gates (ER, WL82-84) takes none. The hypothesis is therefore that learning is confined to K; K is exposed to the rest of the system only through a transition-kernel contract (eval, sample, pdf, certified passivity); and angular support for sharp transport is obtained by sampling C from K's outgoing distribution on the sender side, so that support follows the material and not a fixed ray or bin budget. Under this hypothesis GM1 has no learned global object, and the surface-only stage is an interface and reference qualification stage for the K contract that GM2 will extend to nonlocal exits.
hypotheses.primary_operator_math: (K_a i)(x_o, w_o) = double integral of k_a(x_o, w_o | x_i, w_i; material, intrinsic geometry) i(x_i, w_i) cos(theta_i) dw_i dA_i, in material coordinates; k_a >= 0; sup over the closed incident hemisphere of the integral of k_a cos(theta_o) dw_o dA_o <= 1 (a certificate, not a penalty); k_a = sum over a finite set of lobes k_l, each with exact sample and pdf. Surfaces: k = f_ER(w_i, w_o) delta(x_o - x_i). (C_G b)(x, w) = b(r_G(x, -w), w): a ray cast in the current geometry. T_G = K C_G, b = sum_n T_G^n K e, evaluated by a walk whose scattering transitions are drawn from k and whose flights are ray casts; measurement through the adjoint walk from the camera. No operator other than K has learned parameters. Any stored state is defined as a projection of the physically computed field and assigned to path classes by K's lobe index.
hypotheses.what_is_learned: The compiler from material (and, at GM2, intrinsic local geometry in material coordinates) to closure parameters. Today: the frozen ER compiler (150,848 parameters) producing a 69-float passive, reciprocal state per material [impl]. At GM2 [hyp]: the same contract with an exit-position distribution (x_o different from x_i), i.e. a learned first-exit transition kernel for a medium or transmissive domain.
hypotheses.what_is_physically_computed: C_G (acceleration structure and ray casts in the current geometry), the source field, every flight and every composition of K with C, the ballistic term, and the camera readout. Any reuse across frames or edits is physical state with explicit geometric dependencies.
hypotheses.runtime_inputs_outputs: Inputs: current geometry, per-domain closure states, sources, camera. Outputs: radiance at the camera; optionally lobe-resolved boundary fields. Excluded: scene-pose-conditioned networks, baked radiance, T1 supervision.
hypotheses.persistent_vs_edit_dependent_state: Persistent across all supported rigid edits: compiler weights and per-domain closure states, moved with the domain's frame. Edit-dependent: acceleration structure (2.5 ms in-place edit measured in WL85), any cached relation or radiance whose line set the mover enters or leaves, and the solved radiance. Under a non-rigid edit the deformed domain's K state is invalid and is regenerated by the compiler from the new intrinsic geometry (GM3; untested).
hypotheses.spatial_angular_information: Continuous incident and outgoing directions at the K/C interface; no fixed angular bins for sharp lobes. Position is pointwise for surfaces; for nonlocal K the exit distribution must resolve the diffusion length and the gap scale near contact (WL55). Ballistic and scattered output kept separate.
hypotheses.path_ownership_and_composition: Segment ownership exactly as in Architecture section 2: K owns entry to first exit, C owns exit to next entry. Because the walk alternates one K transition and one C ray cast, a segment cannot be claimed twice. Stability follows from certified sub-stochastic transitions (Neumann series converges with ratio at most the maximum albedo); nothing learned is ever queried outside its certificate. The same K is used for direct and coupled incidence, which ECRO's internal rank-16 scattering did not satisfy.
hypotheses.unseen_geometry_and_illumination: Scene geometry never enters learned parameters, so at GM1 there is no geometry-generalisation question; the only generalisation is across materials (measured: median E_L1 0.057 on 650 new materials, about 0.10 on the hard family). Illumination: exact superposition; narrow sources are handled by the estimator, not by an encoding. At GM2 the question returns as generalisation over intrinsic domain shape and source position, which is exactly where WL57-80 failed (far-boundary transfer 0.67-0.95).
hypotheses.source_of_compressibility: Physical and structural, and confined to K. (1) Intrinsic micro-transport - a layered-coat walk, an in-medium walk with many collisions - collapses to a few lobes or a low-dimensional profile because of local material statistics (ER: 8 lobes; WL66: 3-5 incoming contrast directions for a homogeneous slab). (2) Reuse multiplicity: the same K is evaluated at every vertex of every path in every frame under every light and every rigid edit, with zero invalidation. No compressibility is claimed for T_G or its resolvent, which is non-compact (Soler et al. 2022, survey).
hypotheses.cost_model: Offline supervision: N_materials x c_reference_eval (ER: 3,000 materials); at GM2 N_shapes x photons, the measured expensive item (126 M photons, 380 s, 2.0 GB per 10x10x1 cm slab at 2.5 mm; x4 per halving of cell size). Geometry state: build O(n log n), refit O(n_moved). Relation discovery: none stored. Learned-state generation: O(number of domains) compiler evaluations when a material or intrinsic shape changes; zero per rigid edit. Source application: none separate. Per edit: refit only. Per frame: pixels x spp x mean path length x (c_trace + c_K). Memory: O(domains x closure size) plus the acceleration structure. Directional complexity enters as variance: spp grows for caustic-type families; worst case is sharp chains with small lights, where light-side sampling or manifold connections are needed and cost grows with chain length. Amortisation base is every scene that uses the material family, not one scene family. Measured anchors: ER versus layered reference 44-10,600x per evaluation, 1.45-1.63x per spp in WL84, 2.9x in WL85; cold frozen-ER path tracing 0.73 ms GPU per spp at 512^2 and 0.39 s to reach g (WL85). The hypothesis does NOT reduce the global transport cost at GM1: the per-frame cost is that of frozen-ER path tracing plus any physical reuse.
hypotheses.is_saving_unique_to_learning: Partly. The K saving exists for any compact closure; a physical representation with the same role is a tabulated or precomputed operator (WL55 oracle K: 2 GB and 380 s per domain instance). What learning adds is the generator: a new material or shape gets its closure without per-instance precomputation (WL83). At GM1 the global saving is zero by construction, and any reuse added on top is physical and published (WL84A: all three reuse tracks withdrawn by their own advocates).
hypotheses.how_it_could_fail: (1) A learned global operator beats the best learning-free operator on the same geometry state at matched quality and cost in some class; then learning has a global role this hypothesis denies. (2) No sampleable nonlocal K meets transfer and deformation gates at GM2, leaving only a pointwise BSDF surrogate, which the topic document excludes as a contribution. (3) Economics: even a free K leaves the path-traced per-frame cost; Cycles met the medium contract in 4.7 s at 4 spp against a 190 s oracle update (WL67), and no wall-clock gain was measured for ER (WL84). (4) GM1 as written ('implementing a full retracer does not complete GM1') cannot be completed under this hypothesis without a human decision on whether a learning-free global mechanism is admissible.

falsification.smallest_physical_test: On the already admitted WL86 room (E1 and held-out E2, existing REF-ER / REF-P references, frozen ECRO checkpoints) fill the same 1,270 x 64 table by four routes and read it through the identical readout: (L) the frozen learned operator; (X) a learning-free binned solve on the same 512-ray state using ER's exact bin-to-bin scattering per material; (Xs) X with the light -> sender -> receiver flight of narrow lobes drawn from ER's sampler at the sender; (P) a path-traced table at a ladder of sample counts. Score every gated class with reader-importance-weighted error against kernel GPU time. H1 predicts X about equal to L on broad classes at no more than L's kernel cost, Xs better than L on region C and the panel, and no class in which L beats the best physical arm at matched cost beyond seed spread. One class where L wins by more than that spread falsifies 'no global role for learning' for that class.
falsification.challenging_baseline: The frozen ECRO checkpoints on broad classes (E_H 0.003-0.006 with 5.45x cheaper samples), and cold frozen-ER path tracing (0.39 s GPU to g on WL85); warm path-traced re-rendering is the unmeasured external comparator.
falsification.controls: Stale state; identical readout and identical state rays for L, X and Xs; REF-ER versus REF-P gap g reported per class; at least 8 independent seeds with bias/variance split; kernel GPU time on an idle device rather than wall time (Python tracing is 70-95 % of wall in this harness); per-family truth split (event order, last sender) as in WL86A amendment 1.
falsification.most_likely_decisive_failure: L is cheaper than X at equal broad-region error because X at 512 rays per patch is variance-limited and the learned operator acts as a regulariser (precedent: WL52, learned C +1.76 dB image PSNR over a 128-gather explicit C through variance, while per-port error was worse). That would give learning a global role as a denoiser of an under-sampled relation.
falsification.evidence_needed_before_training: None for GM1 (nothing is trained). For the GM2 extension: a direct-fit ceiling of a sampleable nonlocal closure family on the WL53/55 slab oracle, scored at source positions away from every fitted source and its symmetry images, with a deterministic or low-noise first-flight term (the WL77A confound), plus a per-evaluation cost against the in-medium walk - before any compiler is trained (WL81 rule).
falsification.which_of_five_test_kinds: X versus L at fixed state: operator representability and end-to-end economics. Xs versus X: information sufficiency of a sender-driven relation. GM2 direct fit: operator representability, then learned generalisation. Dynamic response is true by construction for rigid edits (K unchanged, C recomputed) and needs only a reference-agreement check.

hypotheses.relation_to_history_and_prior_art: Continuous with the K/C contract and with GM0; it is the reading of the contract in which sections 3-4 are taken literally. It keeps the WL46 finding (directional sender read plus lobe sampling) and the WL53 ownership result, and discards FNTO v0.1's learned coupling (already NOT SUPPORTED, WL52) and ECRO's learned resolvent. Prior art: this is the structure of every surveyed learned system that shows sharp effects - the sharp relation stays in explicit ray tracing and the learned quantity is local (Neural Radiosity's specular chains, Deep Scattering, Vicini et al. 2019 as a sampling model with a pdf). It carries no mechanism novelty at GM1; novelty, if any, would have to come from the GM2 kernel and from the three properties shown jointly.

hypotheses.name: H2 - Enclosure-bounded intrinsic operator: extend the optical domain to a rigid assembly including its enclosed air (a contract amendment)
hypotheses.central_principle: For any closed virtual interface Gamma around a rigid sub-scene whose interior does not change, the interior's response to the light field incident on Gamma is an exact linear, passive, source-independent, rigid-invariant operator (the interior unknowns eliminated: a Schur complement of the transport system). For a medium, Gamma is the material boundary and this is the contract's K. The hypothesis is that the same object, with Gamma allowed to enclose air (a concave glossy assembly), is the nonlocal intrinsic thing that can be learned at the surface-only stage, in the same sampleable-kernel form as H1.
hypotheses.primary_operator_math: K_Gamma = R_out (I - T_int)^-1 T_in on the 4D ray space of Gamma, where T_int = K C restricted to the interior, T_in maps rays entering Gamma to their first interior event and R_out maps interior exits to rays leaving Gamma. Outside: b = K_Gamma(e + C_ext b) with C_ext owning only segments outside every Gamma. Represented as a transition kernel k_Gamma(ray_out | ray_in) with sample / pdf and a sub-stochastic certificate.
hypotheses.what_is_learned: A compiler from the assembly's intrinsic geometry and materials to k_Gamma (per rigid assembly, in its frame). [hyp] Nothing of this kind exists in the project.
hypotheses.what_is_physically_computed: All transport outside the enclosures, the hull-intrusion test that certifies validity, and the fallback (plain K and C inside Gamma) whenever foreign geometry enters the hull or the assembly deforms.
hypotheses.runtime_inputs_outputs: Inputs: per-assembly kernel state, poses, exterior geometry, sources. Outputs: exit rays from Gamma for each entering ray, used inside an otherwise physical walk.
hypotheses.persistent_vs_edit_dependent_state: Persistent under rigid motion of the whole assembly while its hull is not intruded. Invalid (fall back or regenerate) under hull intrusion, near contact, or any internal non-rigid edit.
hypotheses.spatial_angular_information: A 4D function on Gamma per entering ray. For sharp interior chains its bandwidth is that of the sharpest lobe; an explicit table would scale as alpha^-4 (WL84A derivation), so only a generative sampler could be compact, and its exactness for near-mirror chains is unproven.
hypotheses.path_ownership_and_composition: Segments inside Gamma belong to K_Gamma, segments outside to C_ext; exclusive if hulls are disjoint. This directly contradicts the current clause 'object identity must not freeze exposed interreflection' and 'C includes exposed same-asset paths', so it needs a human contract decision and an explicit validity certificate.
hypotheses.unseen_geometry_and_illumination: Exterior geometry and illumination are handled exactly (they only change the incident field on Gamma). Unseen assemblies require the compiler to generalise over shape, the question on which WL57-80 gave negative transfer results for a simpler domain.
hypotheses.source_of_compressibility: Physical: an interior multi-bounce chain is replaced by one transition. Statistical only where the exit distribution is smooth; for sharp interior transport there is none (space-bandwidth bound).
hypotheses.cost_model: Offline: per assembly family, light-field transport supervision on Gamma (4D input x 4D output samples). Per rigid edit: pose update plus hull-intrusion test, O(number of assemblies). Per frame: paths entering Gamma save (mean interior chain length - 1) segments; ceiling on the saving = interior share of path segments. Measured anchor: 2.36-2.42 segments per whole path on WL85, so on that kind of workload the ceiling is small. Worst case: intruded hulls, where it reverts to full physical transport plus the test. Memory: per-assembly kernel state.
hypotheses.is_saving_unique_to_learning: No. A precomputed physical light-field operator on Gamma holds the same state (radiance transfer fields, Pan et al. 2007; shadow fields; MRT interfaces), at low frequency in every published instance. Learning would contribute only compression or generation across assemblies.
hypotheses.how_it_could_fail: Interior chains are too short to matter (WL85); the kernel cannot be both compact and sharp; hull intrusion is the common case in contact-rich scenes (WL54/55 show near-contact is where the errors are); the contract owner rejects enclosing air.

falsification.smallest_physical_test: A path census on a closed, high-albedo glossy concave assembly inside a larger scene: the fraction of path segments, and of image variance, spent inside the hull under frozen-ER path tracing, before and after a rigid move of the assembly. If the interior share is below what would give a 2x ceiling, stop.
falsification.challenging_baseline: Cold frozen-ER path tracing of the same scene, and a physically precomputed interface operator at the same memory.
falsification.controls: Hull-intrusion negative control (an object entering the hull must invalidate); rigid-rotation control with frame transform; interior-chain-length sweep by geometry only.
falsification.most_likely_decisive_failure: The census shows short interior chains, so the saving ceiling is under 2x before any learning cost is counted.
falsification.evidence_needed_before_training: The census above, and an oracle (physically sampled) K_Gamma substituted into the walk to show that composition is exact and what the saving ceiling is.
falsification.which_of_five_test_kinds: Census: end-to-end economics (ceiling). Oracle substitution: operator representability and dynamic response.

hypotheses.relation_to_history_and_prior_art: It is the surface analogue of the WL53 medium K (rigid-invariant, disjoint ownership) and of the WL55 contact-creating rigid reuse. It reverses a deliberate v0.1 decision. Closest prior art: precomputed radiance transfer fields, NeLT, object-centric scattering functions, Modular Radiance Transfer - all low-frequency between objects. A closed glossy enclosure is unmeasured in the project for both g and cost.

hypotheses.name: H3 - Learned broad-class resolvent as an optional approximation of the physical solve (a restricted ECRO), with ownership by K's lobe classes
hypotheses.central_principle: Keep a learned, geometry-conditioned, source-linear operator only for the part of the higher-order response where finite rank is physically justified: paths whose stored vertex and whose preceding sender both scatter through broad lobes. Every family with a narrow-lobe sender feeding a stored vertex goes to a sender-driven physical estimator; narrow-lobe reads at the camera side are traced. Ownership is by lobe index of ER's exact mixture, applied identically on both sides.
hypotheses.primary_operator_math: Write S_ER = S_B + S_N (broad and narrow lobes by a declared r50 threshold). Stored table B_hat approximates Pi [ sum_{n>=2} (S_B C_G)^(n-1) ... ] restricted to chains whose last two scattering lobes are in B; B_hat = G_theta(geometry state) applied linearly to the encoded direct field. Remaining classes (any chain with an N lobe at the last or second-to-last sender) are estimated physically. Image = traced low-order part + read of B_hat at broad vertices + physical sharp-sender estimator.
hypotheses.what_is_learned: The generator G_theta from geometry state to operator factors, for one declared scene family and material family. Its parameters are scene-family state, not an intrinsic rule.
hypotheses.what_is_physically_computed: Low-order paths, all narrow-lobe sender families, the geometry state (rays), the source encoding, the readout.
hypotheses.runtime_inputs_outputs: As ECRO v0: patch tables, frozen ER states, state rays, encoded direct field in; a patch x direction table restricted to broad classes out.
hypotheses.persistent_vs_edit_dependent_state: Persistent: generator weights within the trained family. Edit-dependent: state rays, generated factors and table, all regenerated in full on every edit (as in ECRO [impl]).
hypotheses.spatial_angular_information: Patch-level position and coarse direction bins are adequate for the owned class by construction; the oracle table shows the container suffices on the WL86 room.
hypotheses.path_ownership_and_composition: Exclusive by lobe class, one-shot (no recursion). The remainder term has nothing sharp left to absorb, which is the intended cure for compensation. The partition threshold is a convention, exact only because the mixture is a sum.
hypotheses.unseen_geometry_and_illumination: Inside the trained family only. Outside it the representation is invalidated and must be retrained - by the project's own baseline taxonomy that is the Neural Full Recompute lifecycle, and inside the family it is interpolation over poses (the Diolatzis 2022 pattern), not transfer.
hypotheses.source_of_compressibility: Physical band-limit of broad-to-broad transport (low space-bandwidth product). The same band-limit is what learning-free caches exploit.
hypotheses.cost_model: Offline: per scene family, geometries x lights x table supervision plus training (WL86: about 15 min + 22 min for two seeds). Per edit: state rays O(patches x rays) (21-28 ms measured), generator and application in full. Per frame: traced low-order paths plus table reads (5.45x cheaper samples than a 6-vertex path tracer in WL86) plus the physical sharp-sender estimator, whose cost is workload-dependent and can dominate. Memory: O(patches x bins) plus the dense form-factor input O(N^2). Share owned: about half of reflected energy on the general material population, a few per cent on the hard population (WL85 census).
hypotheses.is_saving_unique_to_learning: Not shown, and I expect not: a learning-free binned solve on the same state, or a path-traced table, yields the same object. Published physical caches deliver broad transport at roughly 1.5-3.5 ms per frame. The only candidate advantage specific to learning is regularisation of an under-sampled relation.
hypotheses.how_it_could_fail: The physical same-state operator matches it at equal cost; the owned class is too small on moderate-lobe materials; the sharp-sender estimator costs as much as path tracing; the generator does not transfer beyond one room.

falsification.smallest_physical_test: The same four-arm table comparison as for H1, restricted to broad classes, plus the class-share census of the WL86 room by ER lobe index.
falsification.challenging_baseline: The learning-free binned solve on identical state rays, and a path-traced table at matched kernel time.
falsification.controls: Term-wise truth by path family; stale control; held-out edit never inspected; seeds.
falsification.most_likely_decisive_failure: No class in which the learned generator beats the learning-free operator on the same state at matched cost.
falsification.evidence_needed_before_training: The same-state physical comparator and the class-share census; without them a retrained restricted ECRO would again be unattributable.
falsification.which_of_five_test_kinds: Operator representability (class restriction), learned generalisation (held-out edit and family), end-to-end economics.

hypotheses.relation_to_history_and_prior_art: It is what remains of ECRO v0 after WL86A if the sharp-sender family is removed from the learned side; it also resembles the lobe-partitioned track that WL84A's own advocate withdrew. Prior art: Jensen 1996 two-tier structure with the caustic family routed light-side; direct-to-indirect transfer; MRT's low-rank operators. It lies outside the K/C contract's parameter table and would need to be declared as an optional approximation of the solve.

designs.strongest_counterargument_to_own_best: H1 can be read as giving up the research objective at the stage where it is currently being tested. The project's invariant is a learned transport response that stays valid under edits and is cheaper than full physical transport; under H1 the surface-only method is frozen-ER path tracing, which the roadmap says does not complete GM1 and which the topic document excludes as a contribution ('a fast BSDF surrogate'). Its measured economics are modest: 1.45-2.9x per sample and no wall-clock gain. The learned content that would make H1 more than that is deferred to GM2, and that is exactly the object with the worst record in the project: across WL57-80 no learned nonlocal K met a transfer or deformation gate, and exact oracle state mechanisms lost to Cycles by 10-40x on small fixtures. H1 also rests on an untested inference - that ECRO's broad-region result (0.003-0.006 at 5.45x cheaper samples) is equally available to a physical operator on the same state. If the learned operator in fact acts as a useful regulariser there, H1 discards a real lever. Finally, the generalisation 'geometry-conditioned learning fails' is drawn from three mechanisms trained on small distributions (one room, one slab, one synthetic family); large cross-scene models in the survey do transfer to edited geometry at moderate quality, so the failures may reflect training scale and not a principle.
evidence_gaps_that_change_the_decision: Same-state physical comparators for ECRO's table were never measured: a path-traced patch x bin table with the same readout on an accuracy-versus-kernel-time ladder, and an explicit binned solve through the 512 state rays with ER's exact scattering. If either matches the learned operator on broad classes at equal cost, no learned global operator is supported (H1 up, H3 down); if the learned operator wins beyond seed spread, learning has a measurable global role.

Whether a sender-lobe-driven relation restores the light -> panel -> patch family in the same table at a bounded ray count. This separates 'the computational partition sampled the wrong side' from 'the family is not representable in this state' and decides whether WL86A is a sampling finding or a representation finding.

ECRO was never retrained with term-wise targets, importance-weighted loss or a denser state, so operator-family capacity versus identifiability is unresolved (free-factor fit leaves 49-68 %, confounded). Without it a restricted learned resolvent is untested, not refuted.

A closed, high-albedo glossy enclosure is unmeasured for path length, for ER's gap g and for cold path-tracing cost. On the open WL85 fixture (2.4 segments per path, 0.39 s GPU to g) no stored-state mechanism has room; H2 and any reuse argument depend on a workload where that is not so.

Whether any sampleable nonlocal K family transfers to unseen source positions once the first-flight term is low-noise (the WL77A confound on WL76/77 is unresolved and labelled non-evidence). This decides whether H1's learned content can extend beyond a pointwise closure at GM2.

Human contract decisions that change which hypotheses are admissible: whether a learning-free global mechanism around frozen ER can be a GM1 candidate or only a baseline (WL84A open item); whether an optical domain may enclose air (H2); whether multi-light / multi-view / multi-frame amortisation is inside GM1; and where a learned scene-family operator sits relative to the K/C contract, which no canonical document states.

External Neural Full Recompute and warm path-traced re-rendering are unmeasured on every workload; a per-scene-family learned operator such as ECRO has a retraining lifecycle of the same kind, and without that comparison its lifecycle economics cannot be placed.
designs.overall_assessment:
Nothing is selected here.

Where learning has worked [meas]: only in K, and only in its pointwise form. ER is the single learned object that passed representability, generalisation and rendering gates; it takes no scene geometry and is passive and reciprocal by construction. Learned objects that take scene geometry as input have a uniform record: valid and stable when built that way, but either uncompetitive with explicit geometry (learned C: 44-672 ms against 5-11 ms) or not transferring (intrinsic spatial map: 0.79-0.82 against oracles of 0.16-0.27; ECRO: sharp-sender family 1-18 % delivered). Physically computed state mechanisms met most of their correctness gates and lost on economics to quality-matched path tracing on small fixtures.

Where ECRO sits [inf]: beside the K/C contract. Ownership by event count is exclusive, but its learned parameters are scene-family state rather than an intrinsic rule, it substitutes a one-shot operator for 'recompute through the current coupled solve', and it carries a second, binned representation of the local scattering that ER already owns. For later milestones this matters concretely: a shared patch x bin scattering matrix assumes exit point equals entry point (false for transmission and subsurface transport at GM2), every generated factor depends on all geometry so nothing is selectively preserved (GM3), and a new scene family means retraining (GM4 lifecycle).

Status of the hypotheses. H1 (learning confined to a certified, sampleable K; coupling sampled from K; no learned global operator) is defensible and is the only one continuous with the contract and with GM2-GM4, but it concedes that GM1 has no learned global object and moves any novelty to the nonlocal K, where the record is negative. H2 (enclosure-bounded intrinsic operator) is physically exact and weakly defensible; it contradicts a current contract clause and the only measured path-length figure argues against its economics. H3 (learned broad-class resolvent) is weakened: its saving is not shown to be unique to learning and its owned class is small on moderate-lobe materials; it is informative as the control that would show whether learning adds anything on a fixed geometry state. ECRO v0 as built is contradicted on sharp receivers and untested on economics; its broad-region result stands but is unattributed between learning and the truncate-and-read-a-table structure.

What would distinguish a hypothesis from another heuristic decomposition [inf]: (1) the partition is derived from an exact sum the physics already provides (K/C segments, K's lobe mixture) and not from distance, rank or event count alone; (2) each learned term has its own identified target; (3) representability is shown by an oracle in the same family before training; (4) the learned object beats the learning-free operator built from the same state; (5) results are scored per path family with reader-importance weighting against REF-ER, with g reported. On present evidence the statement 'the evidence does not yet support selecting any learned global mechanism' is the accurate one; the comparators in the first two evidence gaps are what would change it.
